name: Safety Net
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach the prevention window. Kate with the Core Set's three interrupts — Decoy, Net Shield, Sacrificial Construct — in an otherwise ordinary Shaper rig. Eternal-legal only. Vantage Point Stage 4a: Sipa for DZMZ Optimizer. Stage 5a: Methuselah for T400 Memory Diamond, Touchstone for Smartware Distributor. Stage 5b: Stowaway for two Creative Commission. Stage 5c: Beta Build for two Diesel. Stage 6b: two Corsair for two Corroder, Lampades for Mayfly, Baker for a Jailbreak. Stage 6c: two Aircheck for two Overclock. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 1: two Coalescence and two Pressure Spike for three Telework Contract and a Creative Commission. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 6b: two Burner for the two Jailbreak, a run on HQ for a run on HQ or R&D. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 6e: two Lobisomem for a Gordian Blade and a Sure Gamble, a decoder for a decoder. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 7e: two Spree for a Touchstone and a Decoy, a run event that moves the deck's Stowaway. The Automata Initiative Stage 2: two Joy Ride for Overclock and Diesel. The Automata Initiative Stage 4: two Living Mural for two Echelon, killer for killer; two Umbrella for two Unity, decoder for decoder, to interface with ice the deck's Stowaway, Spree and Living Mural put trojans on; and two Urban Art Vernissage for two Touchstone, to take a trojan back and install it again. The Automata Initiative Stage 7: two Beatriz Friere Gonzalez for its two Sure Gamble. The Automata Initiative Stage 8a: two AirbladeX (JSRF Ed.) for its two Methuselah, which Spare Parts still carries.
